description: Documents formally retired by an ADR. Retirement is DEMOTION, never deletion (2026-06-05 operator rule: delete only a merged twin), so every path here must still exist and must carry a RETIRED-BY banner near its top. Enforced both ways by scripts/doc-retirement-guard.mjs: a listed doc must be bannered, and a bannered doc must be listed. The authority for WHY each is retired is the superseding ADR, not this file.

docs/DAEMON-MESH-ARCHITECTURE.md.reason: Peer Raft mesh with leader election and multi-writer replication, superseded by the authority-domain model: one writer lease per harbor, authority epochs, no election.

docs/plans/PHONE-INTEGRATION-MASTER-PLAN.reason: Superseded by the phone surface as actually built (native SwiftUI, HITL-first). This plan also promised to update V4-DAG.md and v4.dag.yaml and never did.

V4-DAG.md.reason: Its critical path runs through Part XVII, the daemon sync protocol ADR-0049 rejected in its non-goals. A critical path through a rejected node orders nothing; ADR-0115 absorbed what Part XVII got right.

v4.dag.yaml.reason: The machine-readable twin of V4-DAG.md, encoding the same dead critical path.

docs/recovery/README.md.reason: Claimed precedence over every other roadmap in the repo ('this directory wins') for four months after it stopped being true. The claim is revoked; the directory is retained as narrative history.
